descriptionFull: The Eurasian sparrowhawk ( Accipiter nisus ), also known as the northern sparrowhawk or simply the sparrowhawk , is a small bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. Adult male Eurasian sparrowhawks have bluish grey upperparts and orange-barred underparts; females and juveniles are brown above with brown barring below.
